correction: Round-3 mean ≈ -39U is NOT evidence of favorable delay after signal. It measures mid near bar OPEN → entry, which includes the breakout bar’s own price run. With SIGNAL_DIRECTION_FLIP, that run is typically favorable to the flipped side, producing negative “adverse”. Round-4 mean ≈ +8.9U uses S.close → fill and isolates post-signal delay; that is the correct delay metric. Prior Round-3 interpretation that “chase is not the main issue because move is -39 favorable” must be corrected: that number mixed bar-internal breakout displacement with delay.
